schema.text: When you walk, does the lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff) make you feel less secure?

ar.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: عند المشي، هل يُضعف غياب المراقبة أو إجراءات الأمن (مثل عدم وجود كاميرات أو موظفين) شعورك بالأمان؟

de.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: Fühlen Sie sich beim Gehen durch fehlende Überwachung oder Sicherheitsmaßnahmen (z. B. keine Kameras, kein Personal) weniger sicher?

en.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: When you walk, does the lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff) make you feel less secure?

fa.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: هنگام پیاده‌روی، آیا نبود نظارت یا تدابیر امنیتی (مثلاً نبود دوربین یا کارکنان) باعث می‌شود احساس امنیت کمتری کنید؟

fr.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: Lorsque vous marchez, vous sentez-vous moins en sécurité à cause du manque de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméras, pas de personnel) ?

hu.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: Gyaloglás közben kevésbé érzi magát biztonságban a felügyelet vagy a biztonsági intézkedések hiánya (pl. nincs kamera, nincs személyzet) miatt?

it.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: Quando cammini, la mancanza di sorveglianza o di misure di sicurezza (es. niente telecamere, niente personale) ti fa sentire meno al sicuro?

tr.#When you walk, does the lack of surveil: Yürürken gözetim veya güvenlik önlemlerinin eksikliği (örn. kamera yok, görevli yok) kendinizi daha az güvende hissetmenize neden oluyor mu?
